build_blip2_caption_model: build a BLIP2 caption model with vision backbone, text backbone, multimodal backbone, and vision neck configs
predict_captions_from_images: predict image captions by calling predict on Blip2Caption with a batch of image tensors
compute_caption_loss: compute the captioning loss by calling loss on Blip2Caption with images and ground truth data samples
forward_blip2_in_predict_mode: run forward pass in predict mode to generate captions from images using beam search decoding
review_ignore_llm_keys_hooks: review the static hooks that ignore text backbone keys when loading or saving model state dicts
